name: Amount And Direction 94
definition: Posting of an item to a cash account, in the context of a cash transaction, that results in an increase or decrease to the balance of the account.

AccruedInterestIndicator.name: Accrued Interest Indicator
AccruedInterestIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the net proceeds include interest accrued on the financial instrument.

StampDutyIndicator.name: Stamp Duty Indicator
StampDutyIndicator.definition: Whether the net proceeds include stamp duty amount.

BrokerageAmountIndicator.name: Brokerage Amount Indicator
BrokerageAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the net proceeds include brokerage fees for the transaction. If absent, element is not required.

ResearchFeeIndicator.name: Research Fee Indicator
ResearchFeeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the net proceeds include research fees for the transaction.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money in the cash entry.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an entry is a credit or a debit.

OriginalCurrencyAndOrderedAmount.name: Original Currency And Ordered Amount
OriginalCurrencyAndOrderedAmount.definition: Posting/settlement amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which the cash is at the disposal of the credit account owner, or ceases to be at the disposal of the debit account owner.
